description: Dept. of Forest Conversation- Forest Conversation Ordinance Order Under Section 3 Bandarawadiya Forest Reserve
categorisation: This gazette content contains the declaration of a new Forest Conservation Order under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to declare state land as a Reserved Forest, making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized administrative matter.
